Before and after

Maintenance on sticky notes. Every asset tagged and tracked.

The problem

Maintenance on sticky notes.

Service history lives on paper and in chat threads. Jobs get missed until something leaks or breaks.

The solution

Every asset tagged and tracked.

A scan opens the work order. Photos prove the fix. Reminders go out before the next service is due.

How it works

Four steps, start to finish.

01

We tag your assets

ACs, pumps, panels, chillers and lifts each get a durable QR tag.

02

Scan to report

Anyone can scan a tag and report a fault from their phone.

03

Fix with proof

Technicians close each job with a photo and a note.

04

Never miss a service

Maintenance reminders go out on schedule.

What you get

Built for facility teams, not data scientists.

Asset register

Every asset with its location, model and full service history.

Work orders

Open, assign, track and close jobs from any phone.

Maintenance schedules

Monthly, quarterly and yearly checks, with reminders.

Photo proof

Before and after photos on every closed job.

Manager view

Open jobs, overdue services and response times at a glance.

FAQ

Questions about facility portals.

Do technicians need to install an app?

No. The QR code opens a page in the phone's browser.

Can we import our existing asset list?

Yes. Send the spreadsheet you use today and we load it for you.

Does it connect to the 3D twin?

Yes. Tagged assets can be pinned on your building's digital twin.
